outcome: Incidence of covert postpartum urinary retention (PUR)
cohort: 450 postpartum women who delivered between January and July 2016.
finding: Covert PUR was common (17.49%) and associated with vaginal delivery, episiotomy, and larger fetal head circumference.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was statistically significantly associated with covert postpartum urinary retention.
birth_weight: Birth weight was statistically different between patients with PVRV under 150 mL and above 150 mL.
